sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Re: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
move.body:
Dear your company team,

You emphasise both your skilled team and our long relationship; it sounds like protecting that continuity matters as much as addressing wage pressure. We want a sustainable agreement for both sides, grounded in your stated wage movement and cost share alongside our should-cost estimate. How could greater contractual certainty help you keep the adjustment proportionate to the underlying cost change?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. Our should-cost estimate for this part is on record (cost:part:PH-100).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 48.92 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 24-month contract and the binding volume of 4,000 units per year, which indeed provides the planning security necessary to moderate our adjustment.
We are prepared to accept the 24-month term and your requested 60-day payment period, provided we agree on a unit price of €51.20.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
While we value our long-standing partnership, your proposed price still falls short of covering our verified cost basis.
We are prepared to make a further concession to €50.90, but we must ask you to provide the data behind your pricing expectations if you require further movement.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.body:
Dear your company team,

You have made a further concession while keeping cost recovery central—it sounds like preserving the partnership must also mean a sustainable agreement for your foundry. We respect the confidentiality of your calculation and want to establish a fair pricing basis without asking you to open your books. What external benchmarks would you consider appropriate for assessing the remaining price gap?

We confirm a binding volume of 4,000 units per year for 24 months. What is the lowest price at which you can sign these terms today?

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 49.53 per unit, 60 days payment, 24 months, from 2026-12-01). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
